name: Apostate (Dread Archetype)
body:
The ideals of a nation, faith, or community hold great power over people, and there are few things that a loyalist fears more than their dogma being revealed as contradictory, self-destructive, or incorrect. Apostates utilize this fear as a weapon, depriving targets of the magical connections which so often bolster their resolve. An apostate may work to free others from tyrannical propaganda or crush the resolve of their enemies.

Apostate Philosopher: The apostate adds Diplomacy and Knowledge (arcana, planes, and religion) to her class skills, but loses Acrobatics, Climb, Stealth, and Swim as class skills.

Agonizing Doubt (Su)

When an apostate of 11th level has a shadow twin active, all enemies within 30 feet of the apostate or shadow twin must attempt concentration checks to successfully cast a spell or manifest a power (DC 10 + the apostate’s level + her Charisma modifier). If a creature in the area failed this check since the end of the apostate’s last turn, the shadow twin uses a separate action pool instead of sharing the round’s actions with the apostate for that round. This means that it and the apostate could both make attacks in the same round.

At 15th level, if any creature within 30 feet of the apostate or shadow twin fails their check, the apostate or shadow twin (or both) may project a null psionics field centered on themself for 1 round. The shadow twin does not wink out in the null psionics field.

This ability replaces twin fear.

Apostate’s Deliverance (Su)

At 18th level, the apostate can expend 2 uses of terrors to manifest unravel psionics as a psi-like ability, with a manifester level equal to her dread level.

This ability replaces the terror gained at 18th level.
